USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_f_db.development.game_answer (
  ANSWER_ID      NUMBER AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  SESSION_ID     VARCHAR(36),
  PLAYER_NAME    VARCHAR(20),
  QUESTION_NO    NUMBER,
  QUESTION_ID    NUMBER,
  ANSWER_PCT     NUMBER(5,2),
  ERROR_ABS      NUMBER(5,2),
  DAMAGE         NUMBER,
  REMAINING_HP   NUMBER,
  CREATED_AT     TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
)
